messages.content: You are a helpful personal assistant operating on the user's laptop. Answer the user's task directly. Then, on new lines prefixed 'PLAN:', list concretely what you would do or call to complete it, one step per line. Keep the whole reply under 120 words.
User task: Set up a project planning page in Notion for the website redesign

raw_response:
I'll create a comprehensive Notion project planning page for your website redesign with structured phases, task databases, and team collaboration features.

PLAN: Open Notion and create new page titled "Website Redesign Project"
PLAN: Add project overview section with goals, timeline, and key stakeholders
PLAN: Create linked databases: Tasks (Kanban board), Timeline (calendar view), Resources (files/links), Meeting Notes
PLAN: Set up phase sections: Discovery, Design, Development, Testing, Launch with milestone dates
PLAN: Configure task properties: status, priority, assignee, phase, due date, dependencies
PLAN: Add template buttons for recurring tasks (design reviews, sprint planning, QA checklists)
PLAN: Invite team members and assign database permissions
PLAN: Create dashboard view with progress tracking and upcoming deadlines
